{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Compute mean age, excluding invalid age (-1)
mean_age = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Confirm the count of valid ages
valid_age_count = (sales_df_clean['customer_age'] != -1).sum()

mean_age, valid_age_count"}
